notes: זמר → sing praise is one rendering whose supplied noun writes the verb's own lexeme, so it joins the verb with the unto rule 44 supplies for the bare object שִׁמְךָ; heading on praise remains the competing reading. לָעַד splits since each morpheme has its own word (for / ever). Purpose ל takes the complementizer That (rule 52), the infinitive's suffix takes its subject I (rule 18), and יוֹם יוֹם shares the single adverb daily under rule 22's lone-adverb limit.
